The target of Valacyclovir hydrolase is a complex molecule with multiple stereoisomers, including the (2R,3S,4S,5R,6R)-2-(hydroxymethyl)-6-[(2R)-4-...] structure, which is known to be a substrate for LC-PTP. This implies that the interaction between Moniliforminol A and Valacyclovir hydrolase may indirectly influence the activity of LC-PTP, potentially modulating its function in cellular processes.
